description: An unofficial port of carpetmod for minecraft forge 1.12.2

releases.notes:
- Fixed fakeplayers not being able to drop stacks.
- Fakeplayers can drop entire stacks now, use `/player name dropStack`
- You can now have default loggers, they stay active even after a server restart. Using `/log setDefault`

# v1.3.0 of Forged Carpet is here!
Would highly suggest you update to this version.
## What's new?
- Fake players are finally here, Use `/player` and go ham!
- Client-server rules are now synced, `ctrlQCraftingFix` from recipe book should work on dedicated servers too.
- Vanilla clients can now join a forged-carpet dedicated server.
- Added `/carpet carefulBreak`.

## Changes and Fixes:
- The modid is `"forgedcarpet"` now (was `"fc1122"` before)
- Removed `newLight` and `fastRedstoneDust`, unnecessary duplicate - `MUP` and `phosphor` already have it.
- Lot more compatible with other mods now, tested with SevTech ages and Direwolf. Report any other issues on the github issue tracker.
- Fixed certain errors and crashes with `litematica` and `tweakeroo`.
- Fixed crash with `Applied Energestics 2`, `Extra Utilities 2`, `Compact Machines 3`.
- `Optifine` compatibility!
- Tab screen only appears when a hud logger is active in SP. (Tab screen could be opened always in SP earlier)
- `huskSpawningInTemples` and `antiCheatSpeed` might not have worked with certain scenarios before, should work without issues now.

v1.2.1 of ForgedCarpet is now out.

Changes in 1.2.1: 
- Added `farmLandBug` -> Reintroduces farmland bug where entities teleport on top of farmland that turns back to 
  dirt
- Recipe book support for ctrlQCrafting (similar to carpet-client)
- Fixed profiler crash
- Fix incorrect /fill and /clone command outputs (Fixes #5)
- Profiler now provides detailed output.

v1.2.0 of ForgedCarpet is now out!
With it comes a bunch of bugfixes, features and a way smoother game experience ;)

Changes in 1.2.0 :
- Carpet rules should now load properly when changing worlds.
- Newlight shouldn't lag the game now.
- Removed disableSpawnChunks, tickingAreas, tileTickLimit, commandRNG, commandStructure. (Lemme know if 
   u wanted any of these rules)
- `shulkerSpawningInEndCities` to allow shulkers to spawn withing end city bounding boxes.
- `antiCheatSpeed` option to disable various server side movement limits towards the cheaty players.
- `/carpet carpets` to give non-op players access to certain carpet commands.
- `relaxedBlockPlacement` to allow players to place pumpkins and fence gates in mid air.
- `explosionNoBlockDamage` to disable tnt explosion damage.
- `rotatorBlock` to rotate blocks via dispenser with a cactus.
- `customMOTD` to change server MOTD ingame.
- `railPowerLimit` to change the power limit for rails.
- `desertShrubs` can form when trying to plant saplings in arid climates without water nearby.
- `renewableSponges` via summoning a lightning on a regular guardians and converting them to elder guardians.
- `xpNoCooldown` to make players absorb xp instantly.
- `portalCreativeDelay` -> Portals won't let a creative player go through instantly andHolding obsidian in either 
   hand won't let you through at all.
- Backend changes.
